maria_sales: FYI we rolled out a small patch to the public ratecard — v5.1. This clarifies APAC SKU handling (removes the temporary surcharge for edu/nonprofit accounts), tightens commit-tier definitions, and adds a documented migration-credit flow. Please don't push quotes until you've pulled the SKU map. :wave:
omar_dealdesk: Link? need to update the deal desk template if anything changed
maria_sales: Internal link: https://redwood.internal/pricing/ratecard-v5.1 (summary + changelog). Deal Desk template is under the 'process' tab.
sarah_revops: Quick policy Q: are renewals against contracts signed before 2026-04-01 allowed to keep v5 pricing or must they stick with whatever is current at renewal? We need a clear line for self-serve quoting.
omar_dealdesk: Renewals keep the pricing that was in effect at the time of contract signature unless AE requests an explicit downgrade via Deal Desk and gets approval. Exceptions only for strategic accounts.
kevin_se: Flag from ANZ customers: some want the APAC surcharge removed but still expect a local private deployment. Security ok with that?
priya_security: Private deployment + APAC waiver requires the new Data Residency attestation (section 4.2 in the doc). We also need an up-to-date SOC2 report and an architecture diagram. No attestation, no waiver.
jason_finance: Migration-credit notes: finance recommends capping at 3 months for < $100k ARR deals and scaling linearly up to 6 months for enterprise. We'll publish an amortization CSV for quoting tomorrow.
maria_sales: Ops note: SKU renames are in the changelog. Quoting tool will reject old SKUs. Please sync scripts to the SKU API before mass quoting. Example mapping (for scripts):
```
old_sku: red-infer-gpu-16   -> new_sku: rwd-gpu-16p-v3
old_sku: red-infer-embed-2  -> new_sku: rwd-embed-2s-v1
```
sarah_revops: I can add a simple /sku command to slackbot that hits the sku-map endpoint. Proposed jq one-liner for AEs: `curl -fsS $PRICING_URL/api/sku-map | jq -r '.[] | "\(.old) -> \(.new)"'`
kevin_se: Also a heads-up: ANZ AEs are asking about temporarily waiving the onboarding fee for customers coming off CompetitorY. Is that a standard discount or deal desk exception?
omar_dealdesk: Waiving onboarding is an exception. If it's a one-time $0 line item <= $5k, we can approve on the form with a short justification. Anything beyond that needs commercial sign-off and finance tracking as a deferred revenue adjustment.
priya_security: Reminder: any requested changes that reduce audit logging or remove tenant-level logs are auto-deny unless security explicitly signs off. Include the logging impact in the Deal Desk request.
ratecard-bot: ratecard v5.1 published by maria_sales at 1769999985. Changelog: /pricing/ratecard-v5.1/changelog.
maria_sales: Action items: @omar_dealdesk update the Deal Desk template for v5.1 exceptions, @sarah_revops add /sku lookup to slackbot, @jason_finance upload amortization CSV, @priya_security link the Data Residency attestation in the doc. We'll review in the weekly sales sync tomorrow 9:30 PT. Thanks!
